WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    avg_total_rebate,
    avg_ratio,
    AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM per_order
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    avg_total_rebate,
    avg_ratio,
    avg_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
  FROM with_mean
  WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, relative_ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Orders are the distinct orderslink values among qualifying fee rows; NULL order links, if present, form one group. AVG ignores missing rebate values and ratios, and zero fee rates yield missing ratios. The overall mean is computed across nonmissing per-order average ratios; a zero overall mean yields missing relative ratios.
